invariants.description: Every meta-ledger entry HMAC-SHA-256 chained; chain breaks are fatal.
Meta-ledger is strictly append-only; no mutation or deletion post-write.
invariants.enforcement: os.replace() atomic writes; no delete API exposed

invariants.description: All six Arc II domains registered at init; unregistered domain raises ConstitutionalViolation.
invariants.enforcement: Domain whitelist check on every append_event()

invariants.description: Every invariant entry must carry traceable proposal_id; orphans flagged LINEAGE-BROKEN.
invariants.enforcement: lineage_status field set to ORPHAN; surfaced in matrix and attestation

invariants.description: Meta-ledger attestation certificates require HUMAN-0 authorization token.
Ledger path and HMAC secret fixed at construction; no post-init mutation.
invariants.enforcement: Private attributes set at __init__; no setters exposed

invariants.description: Full meta-ledger replay must produce identical chain hashes — deterministic replay mandatory.
invariants.enforcement: verify_chain() re-derives all hashes from raw entries; compare_digest used

invariants.description: All writes use os.replace() for atomicity; partial writes constitutionally prohibited.
invariants.enforcement: tmp file written then os.replace() — no in-place file mutation

invariants.description: Cross-phase consistency enforced on every append; phase sequence violations rejected.
invariants.enforcement: XPhaseViolation raised; CGML meta-domain exempt from ordering

invariants.description: Every read operation emits an audit event; silent reads constitutionally prohibited.
invariants.enforcement: _emit_audit() called at end of every public read method
